Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 6 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 15 done? What did you finish, what is next, have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll finish it today.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, has been Active for 2 days. Still on track?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, are story 2, bug 12, task 16, and story 5 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for the access to the platform team staging gateway that’s blocking your settlement file validation, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker “Waiting on the security review” and your commitment “I'll chase them today”; the blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thank you, Maya.

Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment to keep working on the payment retry story today.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this sandbox-down issue so task 14 can be completed tomorrow?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised were access to the platform team staging gateway, waiting on the security review, and the sandbox being down. We parked an offline side discussion about the gateway timeouts between Daniel Park and Admin. There were no absences, no one failed to respond, and there were no flagged items that nobody covered. Follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses if they occur, are coming in Teams, and thank you everyone.
